```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum


class HookStatus(Enum):
    """Lifecycle state of an async hook in the durable queue. Satisfies AC-14."""
    PENDING = "pending"
    RETRYING = "retrying"
    DEAD_LETTERED = "dead_lettered"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DeadLetterEntry:
    """Terminally-failed async hook quarantined in `hook_dead_letter`. Satisfies AC-14."""
    id: str
    event_id: str
    retry_count: int
    last_error_message: str
    dead_lettered_at: datetime


def requeue_dead_lettered_hook(id: str) -> None:
    """Satisfies AC-14."""
    ...
```
